extension.description: Browse and update ProofHub projects, tasks, comments and time without leaving the editor.
welcome.contents:
Connect to ProofHub to see your projects and tasks here.
[Connect to ProofHub](command:proofhub.connect)

The key is personal, validated on connection and stored in the VS Code secret vault, on this machine only.
command.stopTimer: ProofHub: Stop timer and log hours
command.moveToRight: ProofHub: Move panel to the right bar
config.account: Address of your ProofHub account, such as yourcompany.proofhub.com. Left blank, the extension asks on the first connection.
config.contactEmail: Contact e-mail sent in the User-Agent header, required by the ProofHub API.
config.archivedProjects: Include archived projects in the tree.
config.apiPagePath: Path of the API access page opened by the Connect command. Adjust it if ProofHub changes the address.
config.openOnRight: Move the ProofHub panel to the right sidebar the first time it opens.
config.syncOnFocus: Reload projects and the open task whenever the VS Code window regains focus.
config.dailyGoal: Daily hours goal, in the H:MM format. It becomes the reference line of the days chart.
config.cacheSeconds: How long the tree keeps projects, lists and tasks before asking ProofHub again. Zero always asks.
config.autoRefreshMinutes: Refresh the tree every so many minutes while the window has focus. Zero turns it off.
